{{Top|leg}}
A '''whipsting''' was a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] bio-weapon. It consisted of a long cord coiled inside the sac of a [[Shaper caste|shaper's]] [[Shaper hand|hand]]. When touched, the living cord would eject at a target. The end of it was tipped with a deadly spine that gave a [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] injection.
